prefix_neighbor_retention.null_definition: Uniformly permute item-to-code assignments, preserving every code occupancy; reuse fixed original-vector neighbor IDs
prefix_neighbor_retention.interval_definition: 2.5th and 97.5th empirical percentiles across permutations, not a recommendation confidence interval

quality_assessment.interpretation: Structural pass only verifies valid artifacts; semantic quality is separately assessed by these item-content diagnostics, never recommendation accuracy.

noise_stability.noise_definition: Independent Gaussian direction normalized to exactly ratio*original vector L2 norm for every item
noise_stability.baseline: raw nearest-codeword semantic SID, identity suffix excluded

baseline_definition: NMSE = reconstruction MSE / MSE of constant training-mean vector; train mean fitted on training items only
limitations: Catalog content diagnostics and held-out item reconstruction are not recommendation accuracy.
LCP is categorical prefix agreement; numeric codeword IDs have no ordinal distance.
Nearest neighbors retain same-title and near-duplicate items after excluding self.
Prefix pairs exclude identical cleaned encoding text and may be unavailable at LCP=3.
Four-category labels are noisy and cover only a small catalog subset.
